why: After a swim, the first real answer (the last lengths were hard, flip turns went better) gets a follow-up on one thing they said; tomorrow comes only after they answer it.

history.text: Morning, Priya! 20 lengths at the pool at 6:30. A photo of your watch when you're out.

plan.reason: Steady lengths build up to the kilometre.

transcript.text: [photo: a swim watch showing 20 lengths, 28 min]
20 lengths in 28 minutes, Priya! 🔥 How did it feel in the water today?
the last 5 were a struggle, arms were dead. but my flip turns finally felt smooth
Smooth flip turns are a big one. What changed that made them click today?
I stopped looking for the wall and just counted strokes
Counting strokes, love it. Thursday: same 20 lengths at 6:30, and on the last 5, ease off to a steady pace instead of pushing. Watch photo after. Work for you?
